title: Varnenska Tropanka, Bulgaria, tutorial di Juancarlos Battilani

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: Juan Carlos Battilani guides students through Bulgarian folk dances using clear step-by-step breakdowns and verbal counting. He demonstrates variations in entry points to match the phrasing of the music.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces himself and the topic in Italian.
Teacher introduces Varnenska Tropanka from Bulgaria and its characteristic rhythm.
Teacher breaks down the sequence starting with the right foot.
Teacher explains starting the sequence from the left foot to match the melody.
Teacher adds arm movements for line dancing.
Full demonstration of the dance with music.

steps_taught.name: Varnenska Tropanka step
steps_taught.description: Step sequence with shuffle and rhythm accents.

what_works: Breaking down the steps with count repetition
Showing how to adapt the entry to the music

quotes.text: La danza che vorrei presentarvi oggi si chiama Varnenska Tropanka
la melodia ci fa sentire molto bene questo un-cia un-cia un-cia-cia
anziché farvi entrare con il destro, preferirei con voi partire a metà frase di sinistro

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher talks to camera wearing red hat and red shirt in a room with white tiles.
Teacher wearing patterned hat and striped shirt explains the dance context.
Teacher demonstrates footwork with back to the camera, counting aloud.
Teacher dances to music with arm movements and shuffling steps.

extraction.distinctive_method: Emphasizing starting the dance on the left foot instead of the right to better align with the phrasing of the melody.
